verified: Tesla's Miami robotaxi service map now extends east from the airport area to Downtown Miami and Biscayne Bay, according to reports citing the map itself (gettesla, Not a Tesla App). Robotaxi Tracker, which tracks the service, says Tesla has run public robotaxi rides in a limited western Miami-Dade zone since July 3, 2026, booked through the Tesla Robotaxi app and with no safety monitor on board.
unconfirmed: The 59-square-mile figure and the roughly 31-square-mile starting point are Robotaxi Tracker's own map measurements, not Tesla's numbers — Tesla has not published an area figure. The claim of 24/7 availability rests on the outlet reports rather than a Tesla statement, and no fleet size, ride volume, safety or incident data, or regulatory approval details were provided; Miami Beach reportedly remains outside the service map.

verified: 多家特斯拉相关媒体与追踪站点报道，特斯拉在迈阿密的 Robotaxi 服务区已向东扩展至市中心和比斯坎湾一带；据 Robotaxi Tracker 记录，该服务自 2026 年 7 月 3 日起在迈阿密-戴德县西部的一个有限区域内提供无车内安全员的公开载客服务，需通过特斯拉 Robotaxi 应用下单。
unconfirmed: 59 平方英里、较此前约 31 平方英里「近乎翻倍」以及全天候 24/7 运营，均非特斯拉官方公布的数字或声明，而是来自追踪站点与二级媒体报道；特斯拉未披露车队规模、订单量、任何安全或运营指标，迈阿密海滩目前仍在服务区之外，扩展后的实际边界也有待独立核实。

titles.en: Tesla Expands Miami Robotaxi Area to 59 Square Miles, Adds Downtown
titles.zh: 特斯拉迈阿密 Robotaxi 服务区扩至 59 平方英里，覆盖市中心
